title: Build Billing from the existing read model
head: Evidence-only commits follow implementation_head; the final evidence commit is the PR head.

design_reference.inspection: Native Figma 17 · Billing inspected in Chrome. Reference screenshot remains private.
design_reference.adaptation: Existing usage contract reports two window percentages, not token totals or a text/voice split. All screenshot amounts and invoices are explicit synthetic preview data.
design_reference.limits: Visual comparison, not pixel diff or full UI35 export.

activation.integration: Existing opt-in Brief Billing room uses useBilling and useHostedBudget; existing daemon authentication/system-owned hosted config and external browser handoff remain the owners.

mapping.plan_renewal: billing-view planTitle/recurringTotal/formatPrice/planMeta; currency-aware minor units and quantities; separate mixed-currency/interval prices.
mapping.usage: useHostedBudget percentage windows; null is unavailable, last reported values are not labeled fresh, restricted accounts do not promise recovery at reset.
mapping.payment: Canonical methods, default/expiry, unreadable versus none.
mapping.history: Canonical paid payments/refunds, net+tax gross, HTTPS receipt links, stable IDs and accessible headers, expansion retains focus.
mapping.actions: Supplied page/manage/changePlan/paymentMethod/cancel URLs via existing openExternal and openedOrHandedOff. GET-only brain reads; no billing mutations or invented success.

License, migrations, template/package checks, 32 related tests and TypeScript. No bypass.

browser.layouts: Eight light/dark × expanded/rail × chat-open/closed at 1440×1100. Table header/cell coordinates align in every layout.
browser.narrow: 800/390/320px long names and 18 invoices: no page, room or table horizontal overflow.
browser.interactions: Keyboard cancellation, blocked handoff recovery, history expansion, canonical state examples. Fixture server rejects API calls.
browser.console: No warning/error entries in final preview.

limitations: No real hosted account or payment transaction; no production deployment or default rollout.
No physical screen reader/touch or cross-browser certification, full repository suite locally, pixel diff or full UI35 export.
The existing usage hook retains last-good readings without a freshness flag; UI says Last reported usage and does not claim a successful refresh.
Hosted schema cannot provide monthly token totals or text/voice breakdown; no fabricated counts.
rollback: Remove the Billing room-local Body or revert D31 commits and use existing Settings → Billing. No data/schema migration. Existing billing store and hosted bridge remain unchanged.
